search_text: published ZDI-23-658 ZDI-CAN-19609 (Pwn2Own) Synology DiskStation Manager api.php Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2023-05-17 CVE-2022-45188 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-45188 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Synology'] ['DiskStation Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Synology DiskStation Manager. title: (Pwn2Own) Synology DiskStation Manager api.php Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Synology DiskStation Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the api.php endpoint. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
